purpose: PP1 diagnosis of possible label-source confounding
interpretation: Origin-only performance indicates how predictable labels are from dataset provenance, even when provenance was excluded from the final model feature list. This is a diagnostic, not proof of causal leakage.
warnings: This diagnostic uses collection source, a deliberately excluded model input.
Training labels are scenario-associated and generated-intent labels, not uniformly verified AWS ground truth.
Even group-separated splits do not remove data origin and behavioral distribution confounding.
